defects_remediated.description: Audio ingress not gated during canary breach
defects_remediated.fix: Replaced static AUDIO_ENABLED with dynamic AudioSwitch.isEnabled() check

defects_remediated.description: Canary reset permanently locked (halted flag never cleared)
defects_remediated.fix: Added reset() method that clears halted flag and re-enables audio

defects_remediated.description: Rollback script restarts without verifying audio OFF
defects_remediated.fix: Rewrote script with verification loop polling /health until audio.enabled=false

acceptance_criteria.criterion: /audio returns 503 with reason immediately after canary breach
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Test B.3 confirmed HTTP 503 with error='audio-disabled' and breach reason

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /canary/reset re-enables audio and clears halted state without restart
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Test B.4-B.5 confirmed audio re-enabled, code review confirms halted flag cleared

acceptance_criteria.criterion: scripts/rollback-audio.ps1 disables audio, restarts service, and /health confirms enabled=false
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Test C confirmed script exit 0, verification loop passed, audio.enabled=false

notes: AudioSwitch enforces runtime gating; canary breach disables; reset re-enables; rollback verifies /health until audio.enabled=false. P3 Windows Collector STOPPED remains non-blocking.

residuals.impact: None - OTLP ingestion operational via Docker-based signoz-otel-collector
